entities.summary: The Second Czechoslovak Republic, officially the Czecho-Slovak Republic, was a unitary asymmetrically federalized country that existed for 169 days, between 30 September 1938 and 15 March 1939. As a federal state, It was composed of Bohemia, Moravia, Silesia and the autonomous regions of Slovakia and Subcarpathian Rus', the latter being renamed Carpathian Ukraine on 30 December 1938.
